offer: Free expression-of-interest test for a narrowly scoped weekly digest of new UK public software award notices for one sender-chosen buyer sector. Proposal only: no digest running, no price, no orders, no collection.
intake: existing private plain-text mail route, identifier site:software-award-brief in mailto subject/body and as manual line
success: At least one actual classified REQUEST or EXPLICIT_INTEREST attributable to site:software-award-brief within 14 days after an ONLINE_VERIFIED deployment and FETCH hash match.
window: Starts at verified deployment time; ends 14 days later. Not started.
unknown_rule: If classified counts stay zero while unclassified sources or skips exist, or the identifier is not in the experiment allowlist, report UNKNOWN, not zero demand.
continue_if: one or more relevant classified requests: produce one sector digest from the official API as a free sample, still no price claims until collection exists
stop_if: window ends with zero classified requests and observability adequate; then do not build monitoring

dependencies.collection: SERVICE-PAYMENT-COLLECTION open; blocks paid acceptance only
